observations.title: Combine stored meal effects
observations.player_action: Load supported edible items or ordinary potions into the Lunch Bag with secondary inventory-clicks, then use the bag.
observations.outcome: Version1.4.1 source consumes the first available item and samples up to three other stored effect lists; when an extra effect applies it consumes another random stored item.
conditions: Commit gradle.properties declares1.4.1-forge+mc1.20.1. Current main1.6.0 and Fabric port differ; their changed consumption/capacity are not substituted. The item has native container-in-container restrictions.
The linked native instructions describe behavior; effective JEM changes and successful action detection remain unverified at runtime.

Exact installed class inspected directly with javap: getItems allocates16slots; finishUsingItem (SRG m_5922_) extracts one initial food/potion, shuffles other effect lists, uses min(3,list.size), and conditionally removes one additional random stored item after an extra effect applies. This corroborates the1.4.1 source, not later24slot/all-consume behavior.
